findings: The original weak facade multipliers made neighbouring panel, plaster, civic and neutral buildings difficult to distinguish. Stable canonical mineral palettes give subdued value and temperature differences at every LOD.

The original windowLight factor was supplied as sRGB-like numbers in a linear glTF field and emitted continuously during daylight. Linearized muted room colour and the existing shared daylight bucket remove conspicuous bright daytime cards while preserving warm night windows.
Existing per-window UVs give a soft dark interior edge. Source positions, normals, texture scale, canonical triangle ranges, picking, source family and scientific data are unchanged.
The actual KAL facade comparison has identical nine GLBs, 59,753,088 geometry bytes, 113 draw calls and 396,705 triangles before and after. All four cited PNGs were opened.
Production daytime and settled nighttime frames compiled without browser errors. Settled pause measurements drew zero frames over 2.2 seconds.

validation.independentCodeReview: no blocking ownership, LOD or shader-uniform issue

limitations: Colours, room shading and light selection are visual synthesis, not surveyed building appearance or observed room occupancy.

The pinned compiler merges wall and some balcony parts by material. In its neutral white-tint bucket, indistinguishable gray balcony parts intentionally follow that material's new finish while keeping their original shade. Other nonmatching colours are preserved.
Preliminary image pairs without a confirmed full ablation reload, and a cold nighttime fallback screenshot, are excluded from this evidence.
This change does not alter window cadence, rooftop fixture density or architectural geometry. A material improvement alone does not certify SimCity-equivalent overall art.
No source, movement, Firebase or Pages publication is asserted by this local record.
